notes: Major UK private (non-council) parking operators that issue Parking Charge Notices via DVLA keeper data. Accreditation: BPA = British Parking Association AOS, IPC = International Parking Community. Both now operate under the single Private Parking Code of Practice.

operators.name: ParkingEye Ltd
operators.scale: Largest UK private operator — 4,000+ managed sites, ANPR-led
operators.notes: Most commonly encountered operator; almost always ANPR entry/exit cameras with max-stay limits.

operators.name: Euro Car Parks Ltd
operators.scale: One of the largest — city centre, retail and leisure sites since 1976
operators.notes: Mix of pay-to-park and free max-stay retail sites.

operators.name: APCOA Parking (UK) Ltd
operators.scale: Europe's largest parking operator; UK airports, rail, hospitals, council contracts
operators.notes: Also runs many rail station car parks where PCNs are issued under byelaws — different appeal route.

operators.name: Smart Parking Ltd
operators.scale: ANPR specialist, hundreds of retail/leisure sites
operators.notes: High PCN issue volumes relative to estate size.

operators.name: GroupNexus (formerly ParkingEye rival CP Plus)
operators.notes: Operates many motorway service area max-stay (usually 2h free) sites.

operators.name: Civil Enforcement Ltd
operators.notes: Liverpool-based; frequent issuer in the North West.

codeOfPractice.name: Private Parking Single Code of Practice (Parking (Code of Practice) Act 2019)
codeOfPractice.notes: 5-min consideration period on arrival before any charge; 10-min grace period after paid/free time expires. Phased implementation from 2024-2026.
